quote_text: Love is a verb, not a noun.
Patience is how love says I'm not going anywhere.
Home is not a place. It is a person you feel safe being quiet with.
Stay soft. Hard walls keep the weather out, but they keep the light out too.
An apology that expects forgiveness is not an apology. It is a bill.
Notice the small things. They are the whole thing.
Every morning you choose the same person all over again. That is what love is.
Tell the truth early. A hard conversation now is easier than a broken promise later.
